spec.purpose: Create a complete reviewable campaign package across selected channels without publishing or spending funds.

preconditions.description: The business brief, market, objective, budget, duration, language, and channels are explicit.
At least two supported channels are selected.
Claims and supporting evidence are separated and traceable.

steps.instruction: Define audience, offer, benefit, campaign angle, objective, geography, and brand direction.
Allocate the declared budget across selected channels using transparent planning defaults.
Produce channel-specific plans and creative drafts in the selected locale.
Verify completeness, language, claims, budget, safety boundaries, and cross-channel consistency.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The package contains strategy, selected channel plans, a landing-page brief, measurement, checklist, assumptions, and approval guidance.
Every factual claim maps to supplied evidence.
No external publication, account modification, forecast, or unsupported statistic is performed.
All quality checks pass before human approval.
